Rules.rule_match: After teams are made you have 10min to join the server or else you are out of the match.
Rules.rule_admin: Nobody move any players after war to WANT TO PLAY channel, everyone doing it themselves. Admin can move players only when we start to play war after teams balanced.
Rules.rule_general: Join WANT TO PLAY voice-channel to introduce yourself, so you can be added to the League

Rules.rule_match: Make sure you have a working microphone unless your team agrees to let you play without a microphone
Rules.rule_admin: Only admins can make servers, put score after match, add new player, edit player, delete player, ban player
Rules.rule_general: Check the #links channel to download the game and custom maps.

Rules.problem_or_ask: I have no fog, how to fix it?
Rules.rule_match: Once a match has started, its result counts, unless both sides agree it shouldn't. Ping, lag issues or incorrect server settings are no excuse for leaving; you should have checked the server before you started playing.

Rules.problem_or_ask: Teams after balanced is not equals
Rules.rule_match: If one team walks away from the match, the score at the time when their last player quit can be considered to be the result of the match by the team that stayed. If this score doesn't reflect the probable final outcome of the match, admins can change it to the advantage of the team that stayed.
Rules.rule_general: Keep the game friendly. If suspect someone, tell an admin. Do not spam the chat.

Rules.rule_match: All programs or files, be they changed game files or new files, that change or edit the game or add to its functionality, or that interact with the game in any way, are strictly forbidden.
Rules.rule_general: Anyone can make Teams for another mix and send the squads to discord in https://mohsh.pl/mix

Rules.rule_match: Custom models and skins are not allowed. This goes for the player models/skins as well as the weapon models/skins and custom sniperscopes.
through/over walls is not allowed. It is exploiting a bug in the map and is considered a cheat.
The use of scripts that change the way spearhead was made are not allowed.
It is not allowed to use a PICMIP setting above 2. picmip 2 is the maximum setting you can choose.
Once the match is over, stay in the server for a while until an admin has taken a screenshot of the scores, STAY 5 seconds after match.
Our ranking is based on a ELO that takes in count the frags of the players. Leave the game before a screenshot is taken and you will be counted no frags and gives a disadvantage of your team
When the match is over and you want to play another match, you have to go to the WANT TO PLAY voice channel yourself.
If the teams cannot agree on which map to choose, the first map is chosen by the team with the higher ranking/chance for win
If the players in the team cannot agree on which map they choose, the map is finally chosen by the player with the highest ranking in the team
